description: #OpMyanmar was launched by #K3yhol3Sec in early December in response to the genocide of the Rohingya Muslim community. Radical Edward sits down with Amber Suzumiya of K3yhol3 Sec to discuss the details of this operation and the cover-up of ethnic cleansing in Myanmar.

faqs.answer: Operation Myanmar is a hacktivist campaign launched by K3yhol3~Sec (Keyhole Security) in early December 2016 in response to the ongoing genocide of the Rohingya Muslim community in Myanmar. The operation combines DDoS cyber attacks against Myanmar government and financial targets with an awareness campaign to expose the ethnic cleansing.
faqs.question: What is Operation Myanmar (#OpMyanmar)?

faqs.answer: The Rohingya are an ethnic Muslim minority group indigenous to the Rakhine State (formerly Arakan) in Myanmar. With a population of over 1 million in Myanmar (roughly 2% of the total Myanmar population), they have historical roots in the region dating back to the mid-15th century. The Myanmar government has refused to recognize them as citizens, attempting to force a Bengalese identity onto them despite the fact they don't speak Bengalese.
faqs.question: Who are the Rohingya people?

faqs.answer: As K3yhol3~Sec worked to raise awareness about the Rohingya genocide, they found that their hashtag #OpMyanmar was outright blocked on Facebook. The operation's event pages were repeatedly removed, and the group lost its Keyhole Security page twice. Despite Facebook's censorship, the group continued sharing information via Twitter and other platforms, tweeting targets they took down and sharing images of the genocide.
faqs.question: Why was the #OpMyanmar hashtag blocked on Facebook?

faqs.answer: K3yhol3~Sec targeted over 400 websites including Myanmar government servers, the central bank, several private banks, and trade networks primarily through DDoS (Distributed Denial of Service) methods. Together with Hacker Paulu, they kept Myanmar government servers shut for more than a week. The group focused on the financial sector to send a message that human life is not for sale.

leadParagraph: #OpMyanmar was launched by #K3yhol3Sec in early December 2016 in response to the genocide of the Rohingya Muslim community in Myanmar. You might be wondering why you have not heard of this operation or the genocide it is responding to. The genocide, while covered by MSM sources, has been twisted into a narrative to justify the brutal murders. As hackers worked to expose this humanitarian crisis, they quickly found their hashtag #OpMyanmar outright blocked on Facebook. Radical Edward sits down with a member of K3yhol3 Sec to discuss the details of this operation.
methodology: Exclusive interview conducted via digital communications with Amber Suzumiya, founding member of K3yhol3 Security.
title: #OpMyanmar Exclusive Interview with K3yhol3~Sec: A Massive Cover-up of Ethnic Cleansing
